global_lower_bound.definitions: At the compatible p=1/2 law, let A be the expected original-denominator fraction first activated by acceptance and B the expected fraction with an installed backup by acceptance.
global_lower_bound.inequalities: Expected service R <= A/2+B; expected invoice K >= A/2+2B; A <= 1. Thus R >= 3/5 implies K >= 6/5-A/2 >= 7/10.
global_lower_bound.scope: Before a unit's first activation, its available own readings reveal only known T0=0 or installed-backup service1. They reveal no T1. Conditional IID profiles and profile-independent exogenous seeds preserve this independence even with earlier other-unit histories and correlated seeds. Repeated mode commands cannot change stable T1; RESTORE selects known-failed T0. Early backups and backup-masked readings are covered by B; repeats and repeated purchases only add nonnegative charges. Later completions cannot increase tick4 service. Therefore the bound covers every supplied legal program capability.
